# Finicky Felicia by Narene Russell

> Finicky Felicia is a children's picture book written by African American author Narene Russell and illustrated by James Scales Jr. It tells the story of Felicia, a little Black girl who loves sweets and refuses healthy food, especially vegetables, until her family finds a way to help her enjoy eating healthier. Every character in the book is Black, and the story centers on Felicia's Black family. The book is for children ages 3 to 8.

This is the official website for the book and its author: https://narenerussell.com/

## About the book

- Title: Finicky Felicia
- Author: Narene Russell
- Illustrator: James Scales Jr.
- Ages: 3 to 8
- Topics: picky eating, healthy eating, vegetables, Black families
- Representation: written by a Black author; all characters are Black
- Paperback: 30 pages, ISBN 9798405203935, published June 16, 2022
- Hardcover: ISBN 9798855615968, Barnes & Noble Press, published September 2, 2023

## About the author

Narene Russell is an African American author, mother of four and grandmother of four who has told stories and made up songs for her children and grandchildren for many years. Finicky Felicia is based on her grandson, a picky eater, and on her daughter's creative ways of getting him to eat vegetables, such as baking muffins with zucchini or carrots.
